title: P256 G528 grouped early abort with receiver-side hash join, expectation-priced Montgomery correction tails and LS64 64-byte transport moves

claims.statement: For the protected full-production P256 target, the cold classical algorithm in proof.md and supporting documents recovers the scalar with probability at least0.39 using expected total work at most78767105042649296866862762955160245037197 scalar instruction equivalents, below2^125.888932763609099 group units at C1000, under the disclosed correction-tail heuristic H_T of proof.md section16; per-run work at most the disclosed worst case in proof.md section15. q1=377464333,q2=2^28,N=2^70,G=528 groups. The run executes contiguous X-row groups in lockstep (per-group hop1 slots of5*2^17 records; a resident receiver that appends each record to one cumulative home record array and joins it at arrival into hash chains keyed by K2 mod2^60 with a packed next-array and uncapped walks; per-group resolution) and halts at the first group whose resolver confirms [x]P=Q (latched stop flag); the expectation charges each group's per-row and per-record work (arithmetic, emission, driver, both hops including the receiver's append and hash insert) and its main-pair hash walks (history-conditional pair counting) times a Chen-Stein prefix non-stopping bound; same-row walks, K2 verifications and defective walks are charged globally without that bound (a listing costs no more than the walk advance it replaces), the seven correction tails per incidence (worst30) by an unweighted global row at15 per incidence over all rows (H_T: expected total excess at most15 per incidence; defective rows at30), and the per-group fixed work of all528 groups, the phase-4 stages, generation, sampling, normalization, the full carry meter cap and all caps, failures, preprocessing, resolution, verification, barriers, control and output at their worst case. Includes construction, normalization, range-tree control, capped carry/failure costs, fixed block-window transport using FEAT_LS64 64-byte moves at the disclosed IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED locations of proof.md section4, hop1 transaction-bound ACK and hop2 DONE-flag completion (the receiver is charged 13 for every potential record; walks 6 per chain visit and 4 per K2 match, by pair counting), hash-head zeroing, resolution, verification and output. Peak memory below2^136bytes; preprocessing below2^119units included; no advice or auxiliary powers. Analytical bound under the stated ideal-coin blocking-port machine, not production execution or formal certification.

experiments.purpose: Check direction/carry-specialized assembly, descriptor invariants, the grouped hash-chain transport replay and the exact E-ledger.
